Subject: Quick technical screen before demo?

Hi Grace,

I signed up for a hosted trial yesterday (account: storefront.ai) and we have a handful of questions about network egress and data retention before we schedule a full product demo. Would someone be able to do a quick 15-minute technical screen with me today or tomorrow? We just want to confirm a couple of things so we don't waste anyone's time in the full demo.

Top two topics:
- Where would inference data sit (short overview of hosted vs. private deployment)?
- Any restrictions on PCI-adjacent logs / ability to mask PII at ingest?

I'm on PDT, available: 11:30–12:00 or 15:00–15:30 today, or 10:00–11:00 PDT tomorrow. If you prefer a Calendly/Zoom invite, send a link and I'll pick.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Somers
Head of Platform
Storefront.ai

- 11:30–11:45 (tight but doable)
- 15:00–15:30 (recommended)

If none of those work, I can do 10:30–10:45 tomorrow.
